summary: Verified Biraajo admin dashboard end-to-end. Admin login succeeds, stats render correctly (4 Registrations, 0 Confirmed, 4 Pending), Registrations table displays ALL 4 reservations with correct columns (Status, Event, Name, Email, Phone, Menu, Guests, Total, Dietary, Submitted). Event/Payment filter dropdowns work, CSV export downloads registrations.csv, and Off-site sales tab loads without errors.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (originates from build-time instrumentation wrapping option children with a <span data-ve-dynamic>). Non-blocking but pollutes console.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx is large (>700 lines) with multiple sub-components — consider splitting Registrations, OffsiteSales, Overview, Messages into separate files.

The <option> hydration warning appears to come from the visual-editor instrumentation adding <span> inside <option>; if this is dev-only tooling it's fine, but verify it does not ship to production build.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing 4 TEST_* registrations were used read-only; no deletes performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified via curl: /api/auth/login (200), /api/stats (200, returns 4 total_registrations, 0 confirmed, 4 pending), /api/registrations (200, 4 records w/ full_name field), /api/registrations/export (200, 949 bytes CSV), /api/admin/offsite-bookings (200). Frontend table maps r.full_name correctly. Registrations UI test rendered exactly 4 rows matching backend. Do not call /api/admin/site-content/reset.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a verification request, no bug. All admin dashboard features working as expected.
